experiment.name: phase9_general_reasoning_transfer_v2_1_2
experiment.motivation: v2.1.1 preserved the strong query-aware procedural path but produced only a tiny residual procedural challenge gain. v2.1.2 tests whether broad transferable reasoning training can improve multiple skills simultaneously without sacrificing RAG grounding, abstention, or short-response behavior.
experiment.primary_objective: Improve broad prompt-contained reasoning while preserving original Phase 9 Real-RAG behavior and measuring procedural transfer as a side effect.
experiment.candidate_zero: the exact input student/adapter under query_aware_v21 retrieval

data.design: deterministic, programmatically verified, real-world-reflected prompts; no external general-knowledge memorization and no chain-of-thought targets

training.strategy: moderate generalization ladder with checkpoint selection; broader than v2.1.1 micro-tuning but far below the destructive v2.1 long-run regime

stage_a.name: broad_reasoning_core
stage_a.purpose: learn a wide set of reusable operations from clean direct reasoning examples

stage_b1.name: generalization_preservation_mix_1
stage_b1.purpose: consolidate reasoning with 40% train-only Phase 9/v2.1.1 behavioral replay

stage_b2.name: generalization_preservation_mix_2
stage_b2.purpose: lower-rate continuation checkpoint; selection can stop at any earlier stage

safety_guard.reason: permit a meaningful broad-reasoning experiment while preventing accidental repetition of the 1e-4/1200-step destructive recovery regime

baseline_axes: v2.1.1 procedural challenge DEV with query_aware_v21
evaluation.sealed_test_policy: Select exactly one candidate on DEV first. TEST evaluates original Phase 9, v2.1.1 procedural challenge, and v2.1.2 reasoning with no retraining or recalibration.

selection.decision_rule: Training is retained only when positive broad-reasoning/generalization benefit exceeds weighted preservation cost. Procedural challenge improvement is a secondary bonus, not the sole objective.
selection.quality_improvement_policy: Positive changes contribute benefit; regressions are charged separately and cannot be hidden by unrelated improvements.
selection.sensitivity_policy: Report both policies. If they disagree, require human review before sealed TEST.

downstream.student_optimization_v2: remain blocked until v2.1.2 DEV and optional sealed results are reviewed
downstream.other_students: If v2.1.2 yields repeatable broad gains, rerun the same fixed curriculum on one or two additional students before changing rank/LR.
